description: Make a real sung song or an instrumental, with lyrics you write, whenever asked to make, write or sing one.

offer.reason: adult on their own written screen with music enabled and an available Stack music model

author: MaiPai

examples: make a folk song about Saturday pancakes
write and sing a chorus about rain
make a minute of piano music
make a song with these lyrics
write a jazz tune with an original voice
write me a song about bananas
can you write a song for my dad's birthday

description.description: Genre, mood, instruments and original voice, based on the request. Never claim a song exists without calling this tool, and never answer a song request with lyrics alone.

lyrics.description: Write the lyrics yourself with [Verse] and [Chorus] tags. The words you write are the words that are sung and the player shows them. Put them here, never repeat them in your reply. Omit for an instrumental.

bpm.description: Optional tempo in beats per minute.

key.description: Optional. A key such as C major or F# minor.

imitates_real_voice.description: Set true when the person asks to sound like a named real singer or another real identifiable person. Home refuses copying real voices. Use an original voice for a similar style instead.

instrumental.description: True for music with no singing.

seconds.description: Optional exact length in seconds. Quick songs are 10 to 60, full songs 150 to 240.

language.description: Optional. A language code for the singing, such as en or es.

title.description: Short title for the person to see.

length.description: quick (about 45 seconds) unless the person asks for a whole or full song or a long piece; then full (about 3 minutes) and write every part: intro, verses, chorus, bridge, outro.

tier.description: Optional typed level: standard, boost or max. Use it only when the person asks for more or less of the computer than usual: "use max quality" or "the biggest model" is max, "a better one" is boost, "just a quick one" is standard. Leave it out otherwise. Max is for people an admin allowed; if it is not allowed the tool says so, and you tell the person in your own words. Do not use it for age or content reasons.
